Comprehensive Mental Health

Understanding Your
Inner World

Mental health is as important as physical health. Our department offers diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental, emotional, and behavioral disorders. We combine medication management with psychotherapy to ensure the best outcomes.

Psychotherapy

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and counseling.

De-Addiction Centre

Alcohol, drug, and tobacco cessation programs.

Geriatric Psychiatry

Mental health care for the elderly (Dementia, Alzheimer's).

Conditions We Treat

Expert Psychiatric Care

Compassionate support for a wide range of mental health conditions.

Depression & Anxiety

Mood disorders and panic attacks.

Schizophrenia

Management of psychosis and delusions.

Bipolar Disorder

Mood stabilization and therapy.

OCD

Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder treatment.

Sleep Disorders

Insomnia and sleep cycle management.

Stress Management

Coping strategies for work-life balance.
